name: Linux runtime (Mali - lavapipe + gamescope)
note: Mali build: Mesa + vulkan-swrast (lavapipe) as the default Vulkan ICD for the runtime; the freedreno/Turnip ICD is removed. The gamescope session and Proton games render on the CPU (software Vulkan), which is slow but boots on any GPU. The on-screen compositor stays the phone's own Mali Vulkan driver. Built by build-linuxfs.yml with turnip_url empty for the Mali fork of DroidDeck.
